title: Keel Infrastructure Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call on November 5, 2026
summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Keel Infrastructure Corp. (Nasdaq: KEEL; TSX: KEEL) ("Keel" or the "Company"), a North American digital infrastructure and energy company, will report its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5 before the market opens.
body_markdown:
NEW YORK, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Keel Infrastructure Corp. (Nasdaq: KEEL; TSX: KEEL) ("Keel" or the "Company"), a North American digital infrastructure and energy company, will report its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5 before the market opens. Management will host a conference call on the same day at 8:00 am Eastern. Q3 2026 materials will be available before the call and can be accessed on the ‘Quarterly Results’ section of the[Keel investor site](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Eiks67AvHQUKOtQsEPL31ZD9K6e5NwUkb1T-V15ytm5RimMBZX_R73ZQpEcBuVMkmNY1qofXtywmrV8N0CiIHAxnYruMYHsOVM_2M0gbOiGdJsS2GVabCtbYsC9C2oPC) .


The live webcast and a webcast replay of the conference call can be accessed[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9xPYjRk9dkLRfzqRUyfEtcPyNKVAYbDxaKar01jLSvjl-yng2AhCCoxjxCSTrUQU9DaOUapgV1PcwHwVpUF_8gfHC9fLEoYSGVcb0Za0HqA=) . To access the call by telephone, register[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9xPYjRk9dkLRfzqRUyfEtVlwhVtUgscs7fogA5nmgv1RIFheAMLSylnR6IpIt12900afkBZIToOzja0KrwawnR8ZSx41u6qmArXC4nJFwai717EsybLj6l_-1iQrGQXmGqT_GFLpP4pbj4-hh2elT_pstGyEw5dU0e1KRhNRwmo=) to receive dial-in numbers and a unique PIN to join the call.


**About Keel Infrastructure Corp.**
Keel is a North American digital infrastructure and energy company that develops and owns data centers and energy infrastructure for high-performance computing workloads, including AI. With a development pipeline of 2.2 gigawatts and established grid interconnections in place, Keel delivers scalable infrastructure solutions in high-demand power markets across Pennsylvania, Washington and Québec. Keel is headquartered in New York City and trades under the ticker symbol "KEEL" on Nasdaq and TSX. Learn more at[www.keelinfra.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Bgy1y-aaFEaWiNYoM6ejgYcoxI5VI3cQR-dnOGj-00PSRfhqvoy6F3LNtJivyv3GZYJqJzvvuqgKMAUgffQBN8S7vnhWnNn5g4gfCMl5x6g=) .
